description: Labeled fictional emails for the Phase 6 live local Gmail acceptance test. Sent to a dedicated test mailbox. All people, places and details are fictional. Results are recorded in docs/use-cases.md.

senderRoles.allowed: The tester's personal address, the only allowlisted sender
senderRoles.unlisted: The test mailbox itself, which is not allowlisted
